mapper.select: SELECT m.MENTORING_NUMBER AS mentoringNumber, m.MENTOR_NUMBER AS mentorNumber, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS subjectNumber, m.MENTORING_TITLE AS mentoringTitle, m.MENTORING_GOAL AS mentoringGoal, m.MENTORING_DETAIL AS mentoringDetail, m.FILE_NUMBER AS fileNumber, f.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME AS fileOriginalName FROM UB_MENTORING m LEFT JOIN UB_FILE f ON m.FILE_NUMBER = f.FILE_NUMBER WHERE m.MENTORING_NUMBER = #{mentoringNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UB_FILE ( FILE_NAME, FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, FILE_SIZE, FILE_PATH ) VALUES ( #{fileOriginalName}, #{fileOriginalName}, #{fileExtension}, #{fileSize}, '/upload/mentoring/' )

INSERT INTO UB_MENTORING ( MENTOR_NUMBER, SUBJECT_NUMBER, MENTORING_TITLE, MENTORING_GOAL, MENTORING_DETAIL, FILE_NUMBER, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{mentorNumber}, #{subjectNumber}, #{mentoringTitle}, #{mentoringGoal}, #{mentoringDetail}, #{fileNumber}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
